datasets.name: top_patients_visits
queryLines:
SELECT
  e.patient_key,
  p.gender,
  p.age,
  p.city,
  COUNT(*) as visit_count
FROM
  workspace.gold.fact_encounter e
    INNER JOIN workspace.gold.dim_patient p
      ON e.patient_key = p.patient_key
GROUP BY
  e.patient_key,
  p.gender,
  p.age,
  p.city
ORDER BY
  visit_count DESC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: top_conditions_by_patients
queryLines:
SELECT
  condition_description,
  COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS patient_count
FROM
  conditions
WHERE
  clinical_status = 'active'
GROUP BY
  condition_description
ORDER BY
  patient_count DESC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: 0651bda5
queryLines:
SELECT
    CONCAT(condition_a, ' + ', condition_b) AS condition_pair,
    patient_count
FROM gold.condition_cooccurrence
ORDER BY patient_count DESC

datasets.name: condition_cooccurrence_stats
queryLines:
SELECT
  'All Conditions' as category,
  MIN(patient_count) as min_patients,
  PERCENTILE(patient_count, 0.25) as q1_patients,
  PERCENTILE(patient_count, 0.5) as median_patients,
  PERCENTILE(patient_count, 0.75) as q3_patients,
  MAX(patient_count) as max_patients
FROM
  workspace.gold.condition_cooccurrence

measures.name: readmission_rate
measures.expr: SUM(CASE WHEN source.readmitted_30_days = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)
measures.comment: Percentage of patients readmitted within 30 days

datasets.name: readmission_comparison
queryLines:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN readmitted_30_days = 1 THEN 'Readmitted'
    ELSE 'Not Readmitted'
  END AS readmission_status,
  'Actual' AS prediction_type
FROM
  workspace.gold.patient_readmission_predictions
UNION ALL
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN predicted_label = 1 THEN 'Readmitted'
    ELSE 'Not Readmitted'
  END AS readmission_status,
  'Predicted' AS prediction_type
FROM
  workspace.gold.patient_readmission_predictions
